text:
sam_marketing: FYI we have two incoming press pickups that quoted our benchmark numbers incorrectly. Need an official correction, exec line, and coordinated social push. @jonathan_pr @legal_kate @ceo_anna

jonathan_pr: Ugh. Which outlets? Can we paste the misquotes?

sam_marketing: TechDaily wrote: \"Redwood cut latency by 60%\" (we reported relative median improvement vs our baseline, not absolute). StartupNews used the same phrasing. Links: https://techdaily.example/article, https://startupnews.example/post

legal_kate: We should request a correction that clarifies methodology. I'll draft a short correction note focusing on phrasing: \"internal benchmark indicates median latency improvements in our test harness; results may vary.\" No numbers in correction.

press_ops: I'll ping editors for both outlets requesting an amend and provide corrected language + attribution. Also prepping a short reactive statement for customers.

oliver_social: For socials we should avoid repeating the incorrect number. Suggest we highlight methodology and link to our bench page. Draft social copy coming after legal signs off.

ceo_anna: I can sign a CEO note if helpful. Keep it short: emphasize transparency and that we'll publish full methodology.

jonathan_pr: Action plan: (1) Legal draft correction now. (2) Press_ops send to editors with 24h to update. (3) Sam prepare a short blog post with full methodology link to be published after corrections are made. (4) CEO note queued if editors decline and we need stronger public push.

legal_kate: Correction draft: \"Correction: Our prior coverage misstated performance claims. Our internal benchmark highlighted median improvements versus the baseline in controlled test conditions. We are publishing full methodology at <link>. We regret the confusion.\" Approve?

sam_marketing: Approve from marketing. Adding link to sanitized methodology doc: https://internal.redwood/benchmarks/methodology-public.md (will make public copy).

press_ops: Sent to TechDaily editor and StartupNews editor with suggested correction and the methodology link. Asked for a reply by EOD.

johnathan_pr: small typo in my earlier msg^^ (jonathan_pr).

oliver_social: Draft social (X): \"We requested clarifications to recent coverage about our benchmark. Weve published methodology and context here: <link>. Always aiming for transparency.\" Will hold until editors update.

ceo_anna: If any outlet refuses to amend, I'll post the CEO note and we will amplify our methodology blog. Please flag if that happens.

press_ops: Editors acknowledged both requests and said they'll patch within 6-12 hours. If unchanged after 12h, we escalate.

sam_marketing: Thanks. I'll finalize the public methodology page and have the blog ready to publish. Keeping social drafts on hold until confirmation.

legal_kate: Keep records of the outreach and responses for compliance. Upload copies to the PR folder.

press_ops: Update: TechDaily updated article and added editor note. StartupNews queued edit. Marking as resolved for TechDaily, pending for StartupNews.

jonathan_pr: Great. Once StartupNews goes live with the correction let's publish the methodology blog and social thread at +5min.

oliver_social: Ready to publish on signal. Queue set.

sam_marketing: StartupNews updated. Publishing blog now, social in 5. Live: https://redwood.in/blog/benchmark-methodology (internal note).

ceo_anna: Posting CEO note on LinkedIn shortly to underscore transparency. Thanks for the fast turnaround team.

press_ops: Closing thread. All outreach artifacts uploaded to /PR/edits/1965000000. :white_check_mark:
